items.text:
1. ESTABLISH – RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA W (Eligibility only, no signs)
2800 block of 24th Street between Bryant and York Streets excluding parcels already in W (Supervisor
District 9) (Requires approval by the SFMTA Board) Gerry Porras, [staff email removed — see the order]

The proposed modification would add RPP eligibility to the residents of the 2800 block of 24th Street
between Bryant and York Streets excluding parcels already in W so they can purchase parking permits
for their vehicle to park within RPP Area W.

Public Comments: Question raised about what “eligibility only” meant.
Decision: Approved by the City Traffic Engineer to forward to the SFMTA Board for final approval and
implementation.
